measurement_definitions.guard_firings: Count [MACROGATE] gate ON transitions for the experiment magic in the cell-owned tester/agent log. gate CLEARED is reconciled separately and is not a firing.
measurement_definitions.affected_new_entry_attempts: Count [EXEC] MACROGATE block active (...) - new order skipped lines for the experiment magic during the exact cell window. B15 parent is STACK_SINGLE and pending mode is off.
measurement_definitions.BASE_new_entry_attempts: Count BASE market new-entry transport request lines in the cell-owned tester agent segment, excluding closes. Require 1:1 reconciliation to BASE entry deals and zero transport/order failure markers. If this cannot be proven, denominator is UNAVAILABLE and interpretation stops.
measurement_definitions.blocked_entry_share: affected_new_entry_attempts / BASE_new_entry_attempts using the same window-specific BASE denominator for REAL_GUARD and all five placebos; null if denominator is zero or unavailable.
measurement_definitions.gated_time: Duration inside the exact cell window for feed rows whose effective native state is RISK_OFF or STRESS. UNKNOWN quarantine is excluded.
measurement_definitions.time_in_market: Union duration of EA-owned open directional-position intervals divided by exact tester-window duration. Unavailable if ownership/open-close linkage is ambiguous.
measurement_definitions.basket_episode: One flat-to-flat EA-owned directional exposure interval. For frozen B15 STACK_SINGLE this should be one position at a time; any overlap/ownership ambiguity refuses rather than being split heuristically.
measurement_definitions.concentration: Calendar-year net distribution plus maximum absolute year-net share of sum(abs(year_net)); null when yearly ledger does not reconcile.

fail_closed_measurement_rules: BASE request/deal reconciliation mismatch => BASE_new_entry_attempts UNAVAILABLE
transport/order failure marker in BASE => denominator not certified
unknown metric remains null/unavailable, never zero-filled
